audit.why: Level chart (Yasuo 1-2, Skill 3 and 4-5, Master Yi 6 and first item, Yasuo two+ items) matches the 48.73% win rate over 630 games and the packet chart; win[] and phases side layers agree (full layer has no entry to disagree with).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike text framed the shift as raw Double Strike DPS and did not name Highlander (85s) or Wuju Style's true damage, and the first-item spike ignored Meditate (10s) refunding the trade.
audit.why: Yi's level 6 spike is Highlander's move/attack speed plus slow immunity, and his damage from level 3 onward is Wuju Style true damage — armour buys do not blunt it. Meditate on a 10s cooldown restores health and reduces damage taken between trades, so Grievous Wounds is the real first-item answer.
audit.corrected: Spike text rewritten to name Alpha Strike's cooldown and untargetability, Wuju Style true damage, and Executioner's timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game text claimed Wind Wall 'covers your entry against his on-hit stream'. Master Yi has no projectile in his kit — Alpha Strike is a blink-strike, Double Strike and Wuju Style are basic-attack effects. Wind Wall blocks none of it.
audit.why: Yasuo W blocks projectiles only. Against Yi it is a terrain/pathing tool at best. Meanwhile the two interactions that do decide the matchup were absent: Alpha Strike (20/19.5/19/18.5/18s, shortened by his basic attacks) makes him untargetable and can eat a Last Breath cast, and Meditate is a channel that any Steel Tempest tornado or Last Breath knockup cancels outright.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall claim removed; Alpha Strike untargetable frames and the Meditate channel-interrupt stated instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal mention anywhere in the matchup, and no warning that stacking armour is the wrong answer.
audit.why: Meditate heal plus Wuju Style true damage — both flagged in missingInteractions for this exact pairing.
audit.corrected: Executioner's added to spikes[2].text and mid; armour futility added to whys[5].

edits.before: His Double Strike DPS starts out-trading your shield and he can Alpha Strike your R setups - stop auto-piloting knockup fishing and shorten trades.
edits.after: Alpha Strike (20s, shortened by his autos) goes untargetable through your Last Breath - hold R until it is spent, and shorten trades once Wuju Style is up.

edits.before: His sustained DPS burns your Flow shield before your burst finishes - do not duel raw; wait for your own item and trade around wave states.
edits.after: His sustained DPS burns your Flow shield before your burst finishes, and Meditate (10s) refunds it - buy Executioner's before you commit.

edits.before: Your crit scaling and mobility make you the safer duelist again - wall his entry, tornado on his Q landing, and never let Highlander start on schedule.
edits.after: Your crit scaling and mobility make you the safer duelist again - Wind Wall does nothing to his melee on-hit, so land the tornado as he lands Alpha Strike.

edits.before: At 5-6 his Double Strike DPS out-trades your shield and he dodges your R setups.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander's attack speed and Wuju Style true damage beat your Flow shield.

edits.before: First item favors him - sustained DPS burns your Flow shield before you burst him.
edits.after: First item favors him - Wuju Style's true damage ignores the armour you built.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 tighten into a skill fight and then tip against you: his ramping attack speed and Double Strike DPS out-trade your flow shield in extended exchanges, and a smart Yi holds Alpha Strike precisely for your Q3 release. Through his first item, dueling him raw is a losing habit - trade short and leave.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 tighten into a skill fight and then tip against you: Wuju Style adds true damage so armour will not save you, and Meditate (10s) heals through your chip - Executioner's makes extended trades work. A smart Yi holds Alpha Strike for your Q3 release; trade short and leave.

edits.before: Late game your crit scaling and mobility reclaim the duel: Wind Wall covers your entry against his on-hit stream, a landed tornado into Last Breath deletes his squishy frame before Highlander resets begin, and your dash tempo means you pick the fight's start and end - just never miss the knockup.
edits.after: Late game your crit scaling and mobility reclaim the duel: Wind Wall stops nothing of his melee on-hit, a landed tornado into Last Breath deletes his squishy frame and cancels a Meditate channel outright, and your dash tempo means you pick the fight's start and end - just never miss the knockup.
